Name: Long Dress Body
Author: RuneNL
Description:
Hi everyone,

After making a short skirt mod I figured why not make a long dress.
Classic or hippy like farming comes to mind when talking about realism.

It's still a work in progress but so far it's a working version.
The body is based on my previous work and includes the adjusted body and animation.

Example of dress with a corset shirt I made.
[img]http://www.direbadger.com/download/Long_skirt_Preview_01.png[/img] 
This shirt, and a few others that go well with the body, can be downloaded here: [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/female-lowcut-shirts-mini-skirt.110494/]http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/216/?[/url]

[b][u]Instructions[/u][/b]
Place the content of the zip file in Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer folder.
Make sure to back-up your old farmer_base.xnb before replacing it.

Enjoy!
